QuestInfo.name: Combat Training
QuestInfo.0: Just your luck. The second lesson at the Crystal Academy is about magical combat, and you can't even get a broom to magically sweep on its own. This is not going to go well.\r\n#bPress the [W] key to check the World Map and move to #m402000527#.
QuestInfo.1: A lesson on magical combat when you can't use magic. Oh well, at least the Practice Robot should be easy to beat, since you have your trusty arm cannon. You hope.\r\n#bEnter the room next to the Training Room and defeat 20 #o2400408# monsters.
QuestInfo.2: You just barely eked out a completion of the Crystal Academy's magical combat lesson. You were the laughing-stock of the class.
